6.348 rsOverallPageNumberInBody
rsOverallPageNumberInBody is a critical error that will occur when an expression contains the
"OverallPageNumber" or "OverallTotalPages" variable from the Globals global collection and when that
expression is not within a PageSection or PageHeaderFooter element.
